summary: International Media Acquisition Corp. filed Form 8-K reporting a $2,000 deposit into its trust account to extend its deadline to complete an initial business combination from June 2, 2026 to July 2, 2026. This is the 18th of 24 possible monthly extensions under the Trust Agreement. No target, terms, or advisors are identified. The filing is purely procedural to avoid liquidation. Watch for whether the SPAC announces a definitive agreement or faces a redemption/trust wind-down if no deal is reached by the final deadline.
